ai_news.headline: Dayforce agrees to acquire Ribbon AI, adding voice and video AI interviewing and sourcing to its Agentic Recruiting product

points.claim: Dayforce has agreed to acquire Toronto-based Ribbon AI; price and closing date not disclosed.
points.evidence: BetaKit 23 Oct 2026 and iTWire/IT Brief 26 Oct 2026 both report terms undisclosed
points.quote: Ribbon accelerates our vision for agentic recruiting,

points.claim: Ribbon's technology will be integrated natively into Dayforce's new Agentic Recruiting experience after completion.
points.quote: integrated natively into its new Agentic Recruiting experience following completion of the deal.

points.claim: Ribbon offers 24/7 conversational voice and video AI interviews, with rubric generation, transcript-based evaluation and integrity checks.
points.quote: High-volume hiring shouldn't mean choosing between speed and a strong candidate experience.

points.claim: Company-reported (unverified): hundreds of customers and more than one million completed interviews.
points.evidence: BetaKit, iTWire, IT Brief (all repeat Dayforce's figures)

points.claim: No continuity plan published for Ribbon customers on other ATS platforms (analyst commentary, single source via search snippet, not fetched).
